text:
Maya: FYI — Acme Prod wants a fast, quantized variant of Magellan-16B (sparse-attn) for live chat. SLA target: p50 <= 150ms, client will stream. They asked for a pilot this week. Can we triage?
Ryan: assigning eng-ml triage. Do we have the model artifacts & HF link? Also sequence profile (512 vs 2k)?
Maya: HF repo: https://huggingface.co/acme/magellan-16b-sparse. Typical seq len ~512, burst up to 2048, streaming enabled. Customer wants INT8 if quality holds.
Anita: I'll take quant experiments. Plan: run PTQ(LLM-INT8) and a 4-bit QAT baseline. Need eval prompt set from customer (dialog style) + 500 samples.
Jorge: I'll handle perf bring-up on a dedicated pool. What hardware do they expect to use? We should try both A100 80GB and H100 configs. Also need model config (layers, kv cache type).
Maya: customer is on GCP (A100) for now, but may move to private infra. Model config: 48 layers, rotary embeddings, kv-cache supported, sparse attention masks applied.
Anita: quick triage notes: potential risk — sparse attention ops may not fuse well in our quant kernels. Start with weight-only quant, measure perplexity + a short chat eval.
quant-bot: Suggestion: run baseline script:
```
python tools/quant/run_quant.py \
  --model acme/magellan-16b-sparse \
  --method llm-int8 \
  --calib-samples 200 \
  --batch-size 2 \
  --out-dir /tmp/magellan_int8
```
Also try `--method q4_0` for 4-bit baseline.
Ryan: good. Anita — can you post a quick ETA for initial numbers? Jorge — can you reserve a test queue slot?
Anita: ETA: 24h for PTQ run + automated eval (perplexity + subset of customer dialogs). If quality regresses >3% on intent accuracy we hold.
Jorge: Reserved a slot on dedicated pool (slot id: ded-313). I'll deploy a canary instance and run p50/p95 sampling. Need a streaming frontend test harness.
Maya: I'll ask Acme for the 500-dialog eval set and confirm streaming payloads.
Anita: quick note — for evaluation use both round-trip BLEU-ish and our question-intent checks. Also include a safety filter regression check.
Ryan: If PTQ passes, we do canary rollout with fallback to float32 variant. Who will own the rollout policy?
Jorge: I'll set a canary with 10% traffic and auto-fallback to float32 if error rate >1% or p50 balloons >200ms.
quant-bot: Recommended quant knobs: per-channel weight quant, asymmetric activations, and enable KV-cache offload during long sequences.
Maya: :thumbsup: Sounds good. I'll coordinate customer comms. Please log experiment artifacts to the Magellan onboarding board.
Anita: logging results to /projects/magellan/onboard/experiments (will attach metrics + short eval report).
Jorge: once perf numbers are in I'll run cost calc (tokens/sec, $/M tokens) and post.
oncall-bot: Reminder — oncall rotation changed; if canary trips ping @oncall.
Ryan: Thanks team — next check-in in 36h or when first PTQ numbers land.
Maya: closing loop: owner list -> Anita (quant), Jorge (perf/deploy), Maya (customer).
Ryan: noted. :rocket:
